name: Water Horse
summary:
You are the Radioman, a crew member of a search and rescue ship dispatched to investigate naval disappearances in international waters. This is the first time you've ever seen a horse hundreds of mile at sea. You are also kind of stupid.

You are also the Viewer occupying the Radioman, psychic cross-examining the scuttling of naval cutter The Breaks in a retrospective scouring for any substantiative information whatsoever before the case is closed. You are kind of stupid as well.

You are both not very smart.
